summary: Current-public D5 source uses the pinned Coordination managed-group owner and existing actual-caller executor rather than shell/job timeout as descendant proof. A closed retained/d5 caller contract extends the existing retained reader only for admission/workflow/unit/clock/owner/evidence namespaces; legacy floors, budgets, original clocks, unit birth/cgroup joins, retirement and retained product route remain unchanged. Cross-caller clocks, admission URLs and evidence outputs cannot substitute for one another. The D5 entry holds before local dependency import or workload effects with ADMISSION=None and a literal-false receiver job. Every executable belongs to the managed executor; no mutable shared-module override or new supervisor is added. The direct current-cohort shell delegates to this entry; historical cohorts remain separate. An expected wrong-profile positive-nonzero command retains its failed original managed receipt, exact profile/argv/core input, image/birth and stream bytes. Signals, expiry, missing evidence, escaped/unreaped members, incomplete EOF, caps and reporting failures cannot masquerade as a semantic refusal. Existing F# ProviderTool remains the backend/source/provenance/whole-owner-file decision owner; transport evidence alone cannot accept a backend. The held source retains three rehearsal receivers and the full raw-plus42-case matrix; all generated receiver evidence uses the maintained bounded copier with a separate D5 inventory. Go/LMT are fixed public inputs and sandbox unavailability refuses without a sysctl fallback. Source controls are synthetic and preserve the original38 controls plus causal namespace/receipt/failure checks; they establish no first genuine D5 run, resource fit, package acquisition, descendant retirement or full4849/4644 acceptance. Proposed two-CPU/8GiB/30-minute unit bounds and a35-minute outer horizon remain unmeasured for D5, with full-matrix fit separately pending. Exact review, native sourceCI and root effect admission remain required; old Unknown holds and prior current build/browser evidence keep their original scope.
title: Current D5 shares closed caller custody while runtime remains held
